pages.privacy.4.en: {t0}Who we are.{t1} Kagemura ("the game") is published by {t2}{t3} ("we", "us"), who decides how the data described here is used (the "controller").
pages.privacy.4.text: {t0}Singobani.{t1} I-Kagemura ("igeyimu") ishicilelwa ngulo: {t2}{t3} ("thina"), onquma ukuthi idatha echazwe lapha isetshenziswa kanjani ("umlawuli wedatha").

pages.privacy.7.en: Representative in the European Union (GDPR Art. 27): {t0}{t1}

pages.privacy.8.en: Representative in the United Kingdom (UK GDPR Art. 27): {t0}{t1}

pages.privacy.10.en: Without online play, your village stays on your device and the game sends us nothing about you (unless you turn on crash reports).
pages.privacy.10.text: Ngaphandle kokudlala ku-inthanethi, isigodi sakho sihlala kudivayisi yakho futhi igeyimu ayisithumeleli lutho ngawe (ngaphandle uma uvula imibiko yokuphahlazeka).

pages.privacy.11.en: For online play we keep what the game needs: an account with a random Player ID, the name you choose, your village and battles, chat, friends and purchases.
pages.privacy.11.text: Ekudlaleni ku-inthanethi sigcina lokho igeyimu ekudingayo: i-akhawunti ene-ID yomdlali engahleliwe, igama olikhethayo, isigodi sakho nezimpi, ingxoxo, abangane nokuthenga.

pages.privacy.12.en: We do not ask for your email address, real name, contacts or location in the game. There are no ads, no tracking across other apps, and we never sell your data.
pages.privacy.12.text: Asiwuceli ikheli lakho le-imeyili, igama lakho langempela, oxhumana nabo noma indawo okuyo kugeyimu. Azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelelwa kwamanye ama-app, futhi asisoze sayithengisa idatha yakho.

pages.privacy.13.en: You can delete your online account in the game or on the web at any time.
pages.privacy.13.text: Ungasusa i-akhawunti yakho ye-inthanethi kugeyimu noma kuwebhu noma nini.

pages.privacy.15.en: Kagemura is a strategy game with cartoon combat, rated for teens and up in the app stores. Before you play online, the game asks your year of birth (and the month, only when the year alone does not settle it) without suggesting an answer, or uses the age range your device's app store provides. It keeps only the resulting age group (under 13, 13 to 17, or 18 or older), not your date of birth, and uses it only to set up the game for your age:
pages.privacy.15.text: I-Kagemura iyigeyimu yamasu enempi yopopayi, ekalwe kwabasebasha nangaphezulu ezitolo zama-app. Ngaphambi kokuthi udlale ku-inthanethi, igeyimu ibuza unyaka wakho wokuzalwa (nenyanga, kuphela uma unyaka wodwa ungakwanele) ngaphandle kokuphakamisa impendulo, noma isebenzise ibanga leminyaka elinikezwa yisitolo sama-app sedivayisi yakho. Igcina kuphela iqembu leminyaka eliphumayo (ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-13, eyi-13 kuya kweyi-17, noma eyi-18 nangaphezulu), hhayi usuku lwakho lokuzalwa, futhi ilisebenzisa kuphela ukulungisa igeyimu ngokweminyaka yakho:

pages.privacy.16.en: {t0}Under 13:{t1} no free-text chat (only a set of fixed phrases such as "Good luck!"), a generated player name instead of a chosen one, and other players cannot find you by name. You can still play, raid and join an Alliance.
pages.privacy.16.text: {t0}Ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-13:{t1} akukho ngxoxo yombhalo okhululekile (kuphela imisho engaguquki efana nethi "Inhlanhla enhle!"), igama lomdlali elenziwe esikhundleni salelo elikhethiwe, futhi abanye abadlali abakwazi ukukuthola ngegama. Usengadlala, ugasele futhi ujoyine uMfelandawonye.

pages.privacy.17.en: {t0}13 to 17:{t1} only friends of your friends can find you by name, and friends do not see when you were last online, until you change these in Settings.
pages.privacy.17.text: {t0}Eyi-13 kuya kweyi-17:{t1} abangane babangane bakho kuphela abangakuthola ngegama, futhi abangane ababoni ukuthi wagcina nini ukuba ku-inthanethi, uze uzishintshe lezi ku-Izilungiselelo.

pages.privacy.18.en: {t0}Under 18 (both younger groups):{t1} a monthly spending limit, an extra "check with a grown-up" step before buying, and no limited-time offers that pop up on their own.
pages.privacy.18.text: {t0}Ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 (womabili amaqembu amancane):{t1} umkhawulo wokusebenzisa imali wanyanga zonke, isinyathelo esengeziwe sokuthi "buza umuntu omdala" ngaphambi kokuthenga, futhi ayikho iminikelo yesikhathi esilinganiselwe evela ngokwayo.

pages.privacy.19.en: The age group is your own statement, not age verification. Once you have said you are under 18, the game cannot switch you back to adult on its own; our support team can, after checking. If you are a parent and believe your child gave a wrong age or shared personal details, write to us and we will help, including deleting the account. These protections apply in versions of the game released with them; older versions ask the age group only before a first purchase.
pages.privacy.19.text: Iqembu leminyaka liyisitatimende sakho, hhayi ukuqinisekiswa kweminyaka. Uma usushilo ukuthi ungaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18, igeyimu ayikwazi ukukubuyisela kubantu abadala ngokwayo; ithimba lethu losizo lingakwenza, ngemuva kokuhlola. Uma ungumzali futhi ukholwa ukuthi ingane yakho inikeze iminyaka engalungile noma yabelana ngemininingwane yomuntu siqu, sibhalele futhi sizokusiza, kuhlanganise nokususa i-akhawunti. Lokhu kuvikelwa kusebenza ezinguqulweni zegeyimu ezikhishwe nakho; izinguqulo ezindala zibuza iqembu leminyaka kuphela ngaphambi kokuthenga kokuqala.

pages.privacy.21.en: Your village is saved on your device. The game does not need an account, and with online play off it sends nothing about you to us (unless you turn on crash reports, below). Gameplay statistics shown in Settings ("Analytics events") stay on the device, unless you are an adult playing online and choose to share them (below). If you play in a web browser, the website that delivers the game sees your IP address, as every website does.
pages.privacy.21.text: Isigodi sakho silondolozwe kudivayisi yakho. Igeyimu ayidingi i-akhawunti, futhi uma ukudlala ku-inthanethi kuvaliwe ayisithumeleli lutho ngawe (ngaphandle uma uvula imibiko yokuphahlazeka, ngezansi). Izibalo zokudlala ezikhonjiswa ku-Izilungiselelo ("Imicimbi yezibalo") zihlala kudivayisi, ngaphandle uma ungumuntu omdala odlala ku-inthanethi futhi ukhetha ukwabelana ngazo (ngezansi). Uma udlala esipheqululini sewebhu, iwebhusayithi eletha igeyimu ibona ikheli lakho le-IP, njengoba yenza yonke iwebhusayithi.

pages.privacy.22.en: What we collect, why, and on what legal basis
pages.privacy.22.text: Lokho esikuqoqayo, ukuthi kungani, nangasiphi isisekelo somthetho

pages.privacy.23.en: The legal bases are those of the EU and UK GDPR (Art. 6) and of Brazil's LGPD (Art. 7). "Contract" means we need the data to provide the game you asked to play; "legitimate interests" means we have weighed our reason against your rights and you can object (see "Your rights").
pages.privacy.23.text: Izisekelo zomthetho yilezo ze-EU ne-UK GDPR (Isig. 6) kanye ne-LGPD yaseBrazil (Isig. 7). "Inkontileka" isho ukuthi sidinga idatha ukuze sinikeze igeyimu ocele ukuyidlala; "izithakazelo ezisemthethweni" kusho ukuthi silinganise isizathu sethu namalungelo akho futhi ungaphikisa (bheka "Amalungelo akho").

pages.privacy.24.en: Online account: random Player ID, a secret sign-in token (we store only a one-way hash), the name you choose, your friend code, your age group, your privacy choices, when you were last online
pages.privacy.24.text: I-akhawunti ye-inthanethi: i-ID yomdlali engahleliwe, ithokheni yokungena eyimfihlo (sigcina kuphela i-hash yendlela eyodwa), igama olikhethayo, ikhodi yakho yomngane, iqembu lakho leminyaka, izinqumo zakho zobumfihlo, ukuthi wagcina nini ukuba ku-inthanethi

pages.privacy.25.en: To run your online account, show your name to other players and apply the protections for your age group. Basis: contract; for the age group also legal obligation and legitimate interests (protecting younger players). LGPD: contract performance, legal obligation.
pages.privacy.25.text: Ukuqhuba i-akhawunti yakho ye-inthanethi, ukukhombisa igama lakho kwabanye abadlali nokusebenzisa ukuvikelwa kweqembu lakho leminyaka. Isisekelo: inkontileka; eqenjini leminyaka futhi isibopho somthetho nezithakazelo ezisemthethweni (ukuvikela abadlali abasebancane). LGPD: ukufeza inkontileka, isibopho somthetho.

pages.privacy.26.en: Your game: your base for raids, the village kept on our server and the actions you take in it, battles and replays, honor, rankings and ratings, a history of resources added or spent
pages.privacy.26.text: Igeyimu yakho: inqaba yakho yokugaselwa, isigodi esigcinwe kuseva yethu nezenzo ozenzayo kuso, izimpi nokuphinda, udumo, izinga nezilinganiso, umlando wezinsiza ezengeziwe noma ezisetshenzisiwe

pages.privacy.27.en: So online play works, raids are checked and fair, and you can continue on another device. Basis: contract; checking battles for cheating is a legitimate interest.
pages.privacy.27.text: Ukuze ukudlala ku-inthanethi kusebenze, ukugasela kuhlolwe futhi kube nobulungiswa, futhi ukwazi ukuqhubeka kwenye idivayisi. Isisekelo: inkontileka; ukuhlola izimpi ukuthi akukho ukukopela kuyisithakazelo esisemthethweni.

pages.privacy.28.en: Social features: Alliance and Gang chat messages, warrior requests and gifts, friends and friend requests, Gangs, Gang Wars and Friendly Duels
pages.privacy.28.text: Izici zomphakathi: imilayezo yengxoxo yoMfelandawonye neyeviyo, izicelo nezipho zamaqhawe, abangane nezicelo zobungane, amaviyo, Izimpi Zamaviyo Nemidlalo Yobungane

pages.privacy.29.en: To provide these features. Basis: contract.

pages.privacy.30.en: Safety: reports you make (reason, optional note and, for a chat message, its text as it was sent), blocks, mutes and suspensions, and the notices we send you about them (kept in your account until it is deleted)
pages.privacy.30.text: Ukuphepha: imibiko oyenzayo (isizathu, inothi ongalifaka kanye, emlayezweni wengxoxo, umbhalo wawo njengoba wathunyelwa), ukuvimba, ukuthulisa nokumiswa, nezaziso esikuthumelela zona ngakho (kugcinwa ku-akhawunti yakho ize isuswe)

pages.privacy.31.en: To keep the community safe, act on reports, tell reporters and affected players what we decided, and handle appeals. Basis: legitimate interests (a safe game for everyone) and, where online-safety laws require it, legal obligation.
pages.privacy.31.text: Ukugcina umphakathi uphephile, ukusebenza ngemibiko, ukutshela ababiki nabadlali abathintekayo ukuthi sinqume ini, nokusingatha izikhalazo. Isisekelo: izithakazelo ezisemthethweni (igeyimu ephephile kuwo wonke umuntu) futhi, lapho imithetho yokuphepha ku-inthanethi ikudinga, isibopho somthetho.

pages.privacy.32.en: Sign-ins you link (optional): the id that Apple, Google or Game Center gives us for you; for Sign in with Apple also the token Apple issues to the game; which sign-in each of your devices used and when it was last used
pages.privacy.32.text: Izindlela zokungena ozixhumanisayo (akuphoqelekile): i-id i-Apple, i-Google noma i-Game Center esinika yona ngawe; ku-Ngena nge-Apple futhi nethokheni i-Apple eyikhiphela igeyimu; ukuthi yiphi indlela yokungena idivayisi yakho ngayinye eyisebenzisile nokuthi yagcina nini ukusetshenziswa

pages.privacy.33.en: To restore your account on another device, sign out devices when you unlink a sign-in, and revoke the game's access at Apple when you delete your account or unlink Apple. We never receive or keep your email address or name from them. Basis: contract, at your request.
pages.privacy.33.text: Ukubuyisa i-akhawunti yakho kwenye idivayisi, ukukhipha amadivayisi lapho unqamula indlela yokungena, nokuhoxisa ukufinyelela kwegeyimu ku-Apple lapho ususa i-akhawunti yakho noma unqamula i-Apple. Asisoze samukela noma sagcina ikheli lakho le-imeyili noma igama lakho elivela kubo. Isisekelo: inkontileka, ngesicelo sakho.

pages.privacy.34.en: Purchases: the store's transaction id, product, price, date and refund status
pages.privacy.34.text: Ukuthenga: i-id yokuthengiselana yesitolo, umkhiqizo, intengo, usuku nesimo sokubuyiswa kwemali

pages.privacy.35.en: To deliver each purchase once, restore it, handle refunds and apply the under-18 limit. Basis: contract and legal obligation (tax and accounting records).
pages.privacy.35.text: Ukuletha ukuthenga ngakunye kanye, ukukubuyisa, ukusingatha ukubuyiswa kwemali nokusebenzisa umkhawulo wabangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18. Isisekelo: inkontileka nesibopho somthetho (amarekhodi entela nawokubalwa kwezimali).

pages.privacy.36.en: Notifications (optional): your device's notification token, the types you chose and your time-zone offset
pages.privacy.36.text: Izaziso (akuphoqelekile): ithokheni yezaziso yedivayisi yakho, izinhlobo ozikhethile nomehluko wendawo yakho yesikhathi

pages.privacy.37.en: To send only the notifications you switched on, never at night or too often. Basis: consent (you turn them on, and can turn them off).
pages.privacy.37.text: Ukuthumela kuphela izaziso ozivulile, hhayi ebusuku noma kaningi kakhulu. Isisekelo: imvume (uyazivula, futhi ungazivala).

pages.privacy.38.en: Network data: your IP address with each request to our server
pages.privacy.38.text: Idatha yenethiwekhi: ikheli lakho le-IP ngesicelo ngasinye kuseva yethu

pages.privacy.39.en: To stop abuse (rate limits) and keep the service secure. Kept only in short-lived counters and in server logs. We do not use it to work out where you are. Basis: legitimate interests (security).
pages.privacy.39.text: Ukumisa ukuhlukunyezwa (imikhawulo yesilinganiso) nokugcina isevisi iphephile. Kugcinwa kuphela kuzibali eziphila isikhathi esifushane nakumalogi eseva. Asilisebenzisi ukuthola ukuthi ukuphi. Isisekelo: izithakazelo ezisemthethweni (ukuphepha).

pages.privacy.40.en: Server error reports: the error, the route, and the request method and path (no query strings or request contents)
pages.privacy.40.text: Imibiko yamaphutha eseva: iphutha, umzila, nendlela nendawo yesicelo (ngaphandle kwemibuzo noma okuqukethwe yisicelo)

pages.privacy.41.en: To fix faults in our server. Basis: legitimate interests.
pages.privacy.41.text: Ukulungisa amaphutha eseva yethu. Isisekelo: izithakazelo ezisemthethweni.

pages.privacy.42.en: Crash reports from the game (optional, below)

pages.privacy.44.en: Play statistics (optional, adults only, below): what you do in the game under a random statistics id
pages.privacy.44.text: Izibalo zokudlala (akuphoqelekile, abantu abadala kuphela, ngezansi): lokho okwenzayo kugeyimu nge-id yezibalo engahleliwe

pages.privacy.45.en: To see where players get stuck and whether changes help. Basis: consent.
pages.privacy.45.text: Ukubona lapho abadlali banamathela khona nokuthi ushintsho luyasiza yini. Isisekelo: imvume.

pages.privacy.46.en: Support email and web deletion requests

pages.privacy.47.en: To answer you and carry out your request, and to keep a record that we did. Basis: legitimate interests; for deletion requests, legal obligation.
pages.privacy.47.text: Ukukuphendula nokufeza isicelo sakho, nokugcina irekhodi lokuthi sikwenzile. Isisekelo: izithakazelo ezisemthethweni; ezicelweni zokususa, isibopho somthetho.

pages.privacy.48.en: If you ask the game to find your Game Center friends, we use their ids once to see which of them play Kagemura; we do not keep that list. We do not make decisions about you by automated means that have legal or similarly significant effects. One automatic safety step exists: a chat message reported by three different players is hidden until our staff look at it.
pages.privacy.48.text: Uma ucela igeyimu ukuthi ithole abangane bakho be-Game Center, sisebenzisa ama-id abo kanye ukuze sibone ukuthi yibaphi abadlala i-Kagemura; asilugcini lolo hlu. Asenzi izinqumo ngawe ngezindlela ezizenzakalelayo ezinemiphumela yomthetho noma ebalulekile ngendlela efanayo. Kukhona isinyathelo esisodwa sokuphepha esizenzakalelayo: umlayezo wengxoxo obikwe ngabadlali abathathu abahlukene uyafihlwa kuze kube yilapho abasebenzi bethu bewubheka.

pages.privacy.49.en: Play statistics (off unless you say yes; adults only)
pages.privacy.49.text: Izibalo zokudlala (kuvaliwe ngaphandle uma uthi yebo; abantu abadala kuphela)

pages.privacy.50.en: When you play online and have told us you are an adult, the game asks once whether you want to share play statistics; Settings has the same switch. It is off until you say yes, and the game never asks, or sends statistics, for players under 18 or whose age it does not know. When it is on, the game sends what you do in the game (sessions starting, tutorial steps, raids with their stars and destruction, upgrades and research started, offers shown, Jade spent on speed-ups and purchases with their product and price) under a random statistics id made for this purpose. The statistics id is not your Player ID and is never sent together with it; the game does not add your name, village, chat or sign-in token, and our server does not store the IP address with them. Saying yes also sends what this device recorded before (so we can see the first minutes of play). Turning the switch off deletes what that statistics id sent; saying yes again starts a new one. We keep shared statistics for 400 days and use them only in totals (for example, how many new players came back the next day). Players who share may receive slightly different timings for in-game offers, to compare which works better; prices, rewards and game rules are the same for everyone.
pages.privacy.50.text: Uma udlala ku-inthanethi futhi usitshelile ukuthi ungumuntu omdala, igeyimu ibuza kanye ukuthi ufuna yini ukwabelana ngezibalo zokudlala; Izilungiselelo zinenkinobho efanayo. Kuvaliwe uze uthi yebo, futhi igeyimu ayisoze yabuza, noma ithumele izibalo, kubadlali abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 noma abangaziwa iminyaka yabo. Uma kuvuliwe, igeyimu ithumela lokho okwenzayo kugeyimu (izikhathi zokudlala eziqalayo, izinyathelo zesifundo, ukugasela nezinkanyezi zakho nokubhujiswa, ukuthuthukisa nocwaningo oluqalisiwe, iminikelo ekhonjisiwe, ijeyidi elisetshenziselwe ukusheshisa nokuthenga nomkhiqizo wakho nentengo) nge-id yezibalo engahleliwe eyenzelwe le njongo. I-id yezibalo akuyona i-ID yakho yomdlali futhi ayisoze yathunyelwa kanye nayo; igeyimu ayengezi igama lakho, isigodi, ingxoxo noma ithokheni yokungena, futhi iseva yethu ayiligcini ikheli le-IP kanye nazo. Ukuthi yebo kuphinde kuthumele lokho le divayisi ekuqophe ngaphambili (ukuze sibone imizuzu yokuqala yokudlala). Ukuvala inkinobho kususa lokho leyo id yezibalo ekuthumele; ukuthi yebo futhi kuqala entsha. Sigcina izibalo okwabelwane ngazo izinsuku ezingu-400 futhi sizisebenzisa kuphela ezibalweni eziphelele (isibonelo, mangaki abadlali abasha ababuye ngosuku olulandelayo). Abadlali ababelana ngazo bangathola izikhathi ezihluke kancane zeminikelo yangaphakathi kwegeyimu, ukuze kuqhathaniswe ukuthi yikuphi okusebenza kangcono; amanani, imiklomelo nemithetho yegeyimu kuyafana kubo bonke.

pages.privacy.51.en: Crash reports (off unless you turn them on)

pages.privacy.52.en: Versions of the game that include crash reporting show a "Send crash reports" switch in Settings. It is off until you turn it on. When it is on and the game hits an error, the game sends the error message, where in the game's code it happened, the game version and the platform to our error-tracking service (Sentry). The game does not attach your name, Player ID, village, chat or save, and removes web-address parameters and anything shaped like an email address from the message. An error message can still occasionally include text the game was working on when it failed. The service sees the IP address the report comes from; we set the service not to store IP addresses. Turning the switch off stops new reports at once.
pages.privacy.52.text: Izinguqulo zegeyimu ezinokubika ukuphahlazeka zikhombisa inkinobho ethi "Thumela imibiko yokuphahlazeka" ku-Izilungiselelo. Kuvaliwe uze ukuvule. Uma kuvuliwe futhi igeyimu ihlangabezana nephutha, igeyimu ithumela umlayezo wephutha, lapho lenzeke khona kukhodi yegeyimu, uhlobo lwegeyimu nenkundla kusevisi yethu yokulandelela amaphutha (Sentry). Igeyimu ayinamathiseli igama lakho, i-ID yomdlali, isigodi, ingxoxo noma okulondoloziwe, futhi isusa amapharamitha amakheli ewebhu nanoma yini ebukeka njengekheli le-imeyili emlayezweni. Umlayezo wephutha usengaqukatha ngezikhathi ezithile umbhalo igeyimu ebiwusebenza lapho ihluleka. Isevisi ibona ikheli le-IP umbiko ovela kulo; siyisethile isevisi ukuthi ingawagcini amakheli e-IP. Ukuvala inkinobho kumisa imibiko emisha ngokushesha.

pages.privacy.54.en: When you report a message or a player, our staff review it and can remove the message, mute chat or suspend the account (see the {t0}community rules{t1}). We tell the player who reported what happened, and we tell a player when we remove their message, mute them or suspend them, with the reason and how to appeal. We do not tell a reported player who reported them. Every staff action is logged so that decisions can be checked.
pages.privacy.54.text: Uma ubika umlayezo noma umdlali, abasebenzi bethu bayakubuyekeza futhi bangasusa umlayezo, bathulise ingxoxo noma bamise i-akhawunti (bheka {t0}imithetho yomphakathi{t1}). Sitshela umdlali obikile ukuthi kwenzekeni, futhi sitshela umdlali lapho sisusa umlayezo wakhe, simthulisa noma simmisa, nesizathu nendlela yokukhalaza. Asimtsheli umdlali obikiwe ukuthi ubani omubikile. Sonke isenzo sabasebenzi siyaqoshwa ukuze izinqumo zihlolwe.

pages.privacy.56.en: {t0}Support email.{t1} If you write to us, we receive your email address and what you send, and use them only to answer you and keep a record of that answer.
pages.privacy.56.text: {t0}I-imeyili yosizo.{t1} Uma usibhalela, sithola ikheli lakho le-imeyili nalokho okuthumelayo, futhi sikusebenzisa kuphela ukukuphendula nokugcina irekhodi laleyo mpendulo.

pages.privacy.57.en: {t0}Web deletion requests.{t1} The account deletion page asks for your Player ID, the deletion code the game gives you, and an optional note. It does not ask for an email address. We keep the request and what we did about it as a record that it was handled.
pages.privacy.57.text: {t0}Izicelo zokususa zewebhu.{t1} Ikhasi lokususa i-akhawunti licela i-ID yakho yomdlali, ikhodi yokususa igeyimu ekunika yona, nenothi ongalifaka. Alicelli ikheli le-imeyili. Sigcina isicelo nalokho esikwenzile ngaso njengerekhodi lokuthi sisingathiwe.

pages.privacy.59.en: We do not ask for your email address in the game, and we do not collect your contacts, precise location, photos or advertising id. There are no ads and no third-party tracking, and we do not sell your data or share it for advertising or cross-context behavioural advertising.
pages.privacy.59.text: Asiwuceli ikheli lakho le-imeyili kugeyimu, futhi asiqoqi oxhumana nabo, indawo okuyo ngqo, izithombe noma i-id yezikhangiso. Azikho izikhangiso futhi akukho ukulandelelwa kwezinkampani zangaphandle, futhi asiyithengisi idatha yakho noma sabelane ngayo ngezikhangiso noma ngezikhangiso zokuziphatha eziwela ezimweni ezihlukene.

pages.privacy.61.en: We use service providers who process data only on our instructions: our hosting provider (server and database: {t0}{t1}), our error-tracking service Sentry (crash reports only if you turn them on, and our server's own errors; data region: {t2}{t3}), and Apple and Google (sign-in, purchases and notifications, under their own privacy policies). Our staff see what they need to answer support and moderate.
pages.privacy.61.text: Sisebenzisa abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo abacubungula idatha kuphela ngemiyalo yethu: umhlinzeki wethu wokusingatha (iseva nesizindalwazi: {t0}{t1}), isevisi yethu yokulandelela amaphutha i-Sentry (imibiko yokuphahlazeka kuphela uma uyivulile, namaphutha eseva yethu; isifunda sedatha: {t2}{t3}), kanye ne-Apple ne-Google (ukungena, ukuthenga nezaziso, ngaphansi kwezinqubomgomo zabo zobumfihlo). Abasebenzi bethu babona lokho abakudingayo ukuze baphendule usizo futhi balawule.

pages.privacy.62.en: Some of these providers may process data outside your country, including outside the EU, UK or Brazil. Where data leaves the EU or UK for a country without an adequacy decision, we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (and the UK addendum or International Data Transfer Agreement) or another transfer mechanism the law allows. You can ask us for a copy of the safeguards.
pages.privacy.62.text: Abanye balaba bahlinzeki bangacubungula idatha ngaphandle kwezwe lakho, kuhlanganise nangaphandle kwe-EU, i-UK noma iBrazil. Lapho idatha iphuma e-EU noma e-UK iya ezweni elingenaso isinqumo sokwanela, sithembela ku-Standard Contractual Clauses ye-European Commission (kanye nesengezo se-UK noma i-International Data Transfer Agreement) noma enye indlela yokudlulisa umthetho oyivumelayo. Ungasicela ikhophi yezivikelo.

pages.privacy.64.en: Your online account and what belongs to it: as long as the account exists. Accounts not used online for {t0}{t1} are deleted after a notice in the game.
pages.privacy.64.text: I-akhawunti yakho ye-inthanethi nalokho okungokwayo: inqobo nje uma i-akhawunti ikhona. Ama-akhawunti angasetshenziswanga ku-inthanethi isikhathi esingu-{t0}{t1} ayasuswa ngemuva kwesaziso kugeyimu.

pages.privacy.65.en: Battle replays and Friendly Duels: 30 days. The last 30 days of village actions on our server: 30 days.
pages.privacy.65.text: Ukuphinda kwezimpi Nemidlalo Yobungane: izinsuku ezingu-30. Izinsuku ezingu-30 zokugcina zezenzo zesigodi kuseva yethu: izinsuku ezingu-30.

pages.privacy.67.en: Handled reports, with the reported text: 90 days after the decision. If a reported player deletes their account, the reported text is removed at once.
pages.privacy.67.text: Imibiko esingathiwe, nombhalo obikiwe: izinsuku ezingu-90 ngemuva kwesinqumo. Uma umdlali obikiwe esusa i-akhawunti yakhe, umbhalo obikiwe uyasuswa ngokushesha.

pages.privacy.68.en: Records of purchase intents (the step before a store purchase): 90 days.
pages.privacy.68.text: Amarekhodi ezinhloso zokuthenga (isinyathelo esingaphambi kokuthenga esitolo): izinsuku ezingu-90.

pages.privacy.69.en: Server logs with IP addresses: {t0}{t1}. Rate-limit counters: at most an hour.
pages.privacy.69.text: Amalogi eseva anamakheli e-IP: {t0}{t1}. Izibali zemikhawulo yesilinganiso: okungenani ihora.

pages.privacy.70.en: Support email: {t0}{t1} after the last message.

pages.privacy.72.en: Purchase records are kept after an account is deleted, without your Player ID, as long as tax and refund rules require.
pages.privacy.72.text: Amarekhodi okuthenga agcinwa ngemuva kokususwa kwe-akhawunti, ngaphandle kwe-ID yakho yomdlali, inqobo nje uma imithetho yentela neyokubuyiswa kwemali idinga.

pages.privacy.74.en: {t0}In the game:{t1} Settings → Online play → Account → Delete online account.
pages.privacy.74.text: {t0}Kugeyimu:{t1} Izilungiselelo → Ukudlala ku-inthanethi → I-akhawunti → Susa i-akhawunti ye-inthanethi.

pages.privacy.75.en: {t0}On the web, if you can no longer open the game:{t1} {t2}{t3}. Enter your Player ID and a deletion code: ask for one in Settings → Online play → Account while you still have the game (it works once and for 30 days; asking again replaces it, and we keep only a one-way hash of it). With the code we carry the request out; without it, we first have to make sure the request comes from the account's owner, because Player IDs and names are visible to other players. We carry out requests within 30 days.
pages.privacy.75.text: {t0}Kuwebhu, uma ungasakwazi ukuvula igeyimu:{t1} {t2}{t3}. Faka i-ID yakho yomdlali nekhodi yokususa: yicele ku-Izilungiselelo → Ukudlala ku-inthanethi → I-akhawunti ngenkathi usenayo igeyimu (isebenza kanye nezinsuku ezingu-30; ukucela futhi kuyayishintsha, futhi sigcina kuphela i-hash yayo yendlela eyodwa). Ngekhodi sifeza isicelo; ngaphandle kwayo, kufanele siqale siqiniseke ukuthi isicelo sivela kumnikazi we-akhawunti, ngoba ama-ID abadlali namagama ayabonakala kwabanye abadlali. Sifeza izicelo kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30.

pages.privacy.76.en: Deleting removes your online account, name, base, chat messages, friends, Gang membership, reports you made, linked sign-ins and the village kept on our server. If you linked Sign in with Apple, we also ask Apple to revoke the game's access. Raids you made stay in other players' replays as "Deleted player"; purchase records stay without your Player ID (above).
pages.privacy.76.text: Ukususa kususa i-akhawunti yakho ye-inthanethi, igama, inqaba, imilayezo yengxoxo, abangane, ubulungu beviyo, imibiko oyenzile, izindlela zokungena ezixhunyanisiwe nesigodi esigcinwe kuseva yethu. Uma uxhumanise u-Ngena nge-Apple, siphinde sicele i-Apple ukuthi ihoxise ukufinyelela kwegeyimu. Ukugasela okwenzile kuhlala ekuphindweni kwabanye abadlali njengo-"Umdlali osusiwe"; amarekhodi okuthenga ahlala ngaphandle kwe-ID yakho yomdlali (ngenhla).

pages.privacy.77.en: {t0}Your village on the device{t1} is removed by uninstalling the app or clearing the site's data in your browser; Settings → "Start a new village" replaces it.
pages.privacy.77.text: {t0}Isigodi sakho kudivayisi{t1} sisuswa ngokukhipha i-app noma ngokusula idatha yesayithi esipheqululini sakho; Izilungiselelo → "Qala isigodi esisha" kusishintsha.

pages.privacy.79.en: Wherever you live, you can ask us to:
pages.privacy.79.text: Noma ngabe uhlala kuphi, ungasicela ukuthi:

pages.privacy.80.en: {t0}access{t1} your data and get a copy, and receive the data you gave us in a commonly used, machine-readable form ({t2}portability{t3});
pages.privacy.80.text: {t0}ufinyelele{t1} idatha yakho futhi uthole ikhophi, futhi wamukele idatha osinike yona ngendlela esetshenziswa kakhulu, efundeka ngomshini ({t2}ukuthutheka{t3});

pages.privacy.82.en: {t0}restrict{t1} how we use it while a question is being settled, and {t2}object{t3} to uses based on legitimate interests;
pages.privacy.82.text: {t0}ukhawulele{t1} indlela esiyisebenzisa ngayo ngenkathi umbuzo usaxazululwa, futhi {t2}uphikise{t3} ukusetshenziswa okusekelwe ezithakazelweni ezisemthethweni;

pages.privacy.83.en: {t0}withdraw consent{t1} at any time (crash reports, play statistics, notifications: Settings), without affecting what happened before. Turning play statistics off also deletes what was shared.
pages.privacy.83.text: {t0}uhoxise imvume{t1} noma nini (imibiko yokuphahlazeka, izibalo zokudlala, izaziso: Izilungiselelo), ngaphandle kokuthinta okwenzeka ngaphambili. Ukuvala izibalo zokudlala kuphinde kususe lokho okwabelwane ngakho.

pages.privacy.84.en: Write to {t0}{t1} with your Player ID. We answer within one month (in Brazil, within the time the LGPD sets; in California, within 45 days) and may need to confirm the account is yours first. You can also complain to a data protection authority: in the EU the authority where you live or work, in the UK the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk), in Brazil the ANPD (gov.br/anpd). Residents of California have the rights of the CCPA/CPRA, including to know, delete, correct and not be discriminated against for using them; we do not sell or share personal information as those laws define it. Under the LGPD you can also ask for confirmation that we process your data, anonymisation, information about whom we share it with, and the consequences of refusing consent.
pages.privacy.84.text: Bhalela {t0}{t1} ne-ID yakho yomdlali. Siphendula kungakapheli inyanga eyodwa (eBrazil, ngesikhathi esibekwe yi-LGPD; eCalifornia, kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-45) futhi kungase kudingeke siqale siqinisekise ukuthi i-akhawunti ingeyakho. Ungakhalaza nakwisiphathimandla sokuvikelwa kwedatha: e-EU isiphathimandla salapho uhlala khona noma usebenza khona, e-UK i-Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk), eBrazil i-ANPD (gov.br/anpd). Izakhamuzi zaseCalifornia zinamalungelo e-CCPA/CPRA, kuhlanganise nelokwazi, lokususa, lokulungisa nelokungabandlululwa ngokuwasebenzisa; asithengisi noma sabelane ngolwazi lomuntu siqu njengoba leyo mithetho ilichaza. Ngaphansi kwe-LGPD ungacela nokuqinisekiswa kokuthi siyayicubungula idatha yakho, ukwenziwa kwayo ingaziwa, ulwazi mayelana nalabo esabelana nabo ngayo, nemiphumela yokwenqaba imvume.

pages.privacy.86.en: Purchases are made through the App Store or Google Play. They handle your payment details; we never see them. The {t0}terms of service{t1} describe Jade and other purchases.
pages.privacy.86.text: Ukuthenga kwenziwa nge-App Store noma nge-Google Play. Bona basingatha imininingwane yakho yokukhokha; thina asisoze sayibona. {t0}Imigomo yesevisi{t1} ichaza ijeyidi nokunye ukuthenga.

pages.privacy.88.en: The game talks to our server only over encrypted connections (HTTPS), sign-in tokens are stored as one-way hashes, and staff access is limited and logged. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects you, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.
pages.privacy.88.text: Igeyimu ixhumana neseva yethu kuphela ngoxhumano olubethelwe (HTTPS), amathokheni okungena agcinwa njengama-hash endlela eyodwa, futhi ukufinyelela kwabasebenzi kunomkhawulo futhi kuyaqoshwa. Alukho uhlelo oluphephe ngokuphelele; uma ukwephulwa kukuthinta, sizokutshela wena neziphathimandla njengoba umthetho udinga.

pages.privacy.90.en: We update this page and its date when what we collect changes, and tell players in the game about important changes.
pages.privacy.90.text: Siyalibuyekeza leli khasi nosuku lwalo lapho lokho esikuqoqayo kushintsha, futhi sitshele abadlali kugeyimu ngoshintsho olubalulekile.

pages.support.6.en: If you play online, include your Player ID (Settings → Online play → Account) and, for a purchase, the date and the store's order number. Never send your save code or anyone's password.
pages.support.6.text: Uma udlala ku-inthanethi, faka i-ID yakho yomdlali (Izilungiselelo → Ukudlala ku-inthanethi → I-akhawunti) futhi, ekuthengeni, usuku nenombolo ye-oda yesitolo. Ungalokothi uthumele ikhodi yakho yokulondoloza noma iphasiwedi yanoma ubani.

pages.support.7.en: My village is gone or looks wrong
pages.support.7.text: Isigodi sami silahlekile noma sibukeka singalungile

pages.support.8.en: Your village is saved on this device. If the game could not read a save, it keeps it: look for {t0}Earlier villages{t1} in Settings and tap Restore.
pages.support.8.text: Isigodi sakho silondolozwe kule divayisi. Uma igeyimu ingakwazanga ukufunda okulondoloziwe, iyakugcina: bheka {t0}Izigodi zangaphambili{t1} ku-Izilungiselelo bese uthinta u-Buyisa.

pages.support.9.en: To move a village to another device, use Settings → {t0}Copy save code{t1} on the old device and {t2}Load from code{t3} on the new one. A village kept on our server comes back when you sign in on the new device with a sign-in you linked (Settings → Online play → Account → Sign-ins).
pages.support.9.text: Ukuze uthuthele isigodi kwenye idivayisi, sebenzisa Izilungiselelo → {t0}Kopisha ikhodi yokulondoloza{t1} kudivayisi endala kanye no-{t2}Layisha ngekhodi{t3} kwentsha. Isigodi esigcinwe kuseva yethu siyabuya lapho ungena kudivayisi entsha ngendlela yokungena oyixhumanisile (Izilungiselelo → Ukudlala ku-inthanethi → I-akhawunti → Izindlela zokungena).

pages.support.10.en: If the game says the village is {t0}open somewhere else{t1}, close the other tab or app: only the one opened last saves.
pages.support.10.text: Uma igeyimu ithi isigodi {t0}sivuliwe kwenye indawo{t1}, vala enye ithebhu noma i-app: yileyo evulwe okokugcina kuphela elondolozayo.

pages.support.12.en: If a purchase did not arrive, open the Store and tap {t0}Restore purchases{t1} while online. A purchase waiting for a parent's approval or the store arrives when it is approved.
pages.support.12.text: Uma ukuthenga kungafikanga, vula Isitolo bese uthinta u-{t0}Buyisa ukuthenga{t1} ngenkathi uxhunyiwe. Ukuthenga okulinde ukugunyazwa ngumzali noma yisitolo kufika lapho sekugunyaziwe.

pages.support.13.en: Refunds are handled by Apple or Google: ask them through your App Store or Google Play purchase history. When a store refunds a purchase, what it gave can be taken back from a village kept on our server.
pages.support.13.text: Ukubuyiswa kwemali kusingathwa yi-Apple noma yi-Google: bacele ngomlando wakho wokuthenga we-App Store noma we-Google Play. Uma isitolo sibuyisela imali yokuthenga, lokho okwanikwa kungathathwa esigodini esigcinwe kuseva yethu.

pages.support.14.en: Players under 18 have a monthly spending limit. If you said you are under 18 by mistake, write to us with your Player ID: the game cannot switch back to adult on its own.
pages.support.14.text: Abadlali abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 banomkhawulo wokusebenzisa imali wanyanga zonke. Uma uthe ungaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 ngephutha, sibhalele ne-ID yakho yomdlali: igeyimu ayikwazi ukukubuyisela kubantu abadala ngokwayo.

pages.support.15.en: The web version of the game sells nothing.

pages.support.16.en: Jade has no cash value and does not expire; see the {t0}terms of service{t1}. For players in Japan: {t2}特定商取引法に基づく表記{t3} · {t4}資金決済法に基づく表示{t5}.
pages.support.16.text: Ijeyidi alinalo inani lemali futhi aliphelelwa yisikhathi; bheka {t0}imigomo yesevisi{t1}. Kubadlali baseJapane: {t2}特定商取引法に基づく表記{t3} · {t4}資金決済法に基づく表示{t5}.

pages.support.18.en: {t0}No connection{t1}: you can keep building; if your village is kept on our server, the game keeps your actions and sends them when you are back online. Raids on real players, Alliances, friends and purchases need a connection.
pages.support.18.text: {t0}Akukho xhumano{t1}: ungaqhubeka wakha; uma isigodi sakho sigcinwe kuseva yethu, igeyimu igcina izenzo zakho futhi izithumele lapho usubuyele ku-inthanethi. Ukugasela abadlali bangempela, imifelandawonye, abangane nokuthenga kudinga uxhumano.

pages.support.19.en: {t0}Update needed{t1}: install the latest version from your store, or reload the web page.
pages.support.19.text: {t0}Kudingeka ukubuyekeza{t1}: faka uhlobo lwakamuva kusuka esitolo sakho, noma ulayishe kabusha ikhasi lewebhu.

pages.support.20.en: {t0}Suspended or muted{t1}: the account broke the {t2}community rules{t3}. The game tells you why and for how long. To appeal, write to us with your Player ID within six months: someone who did not take the first decision looks at it again.
pages.support.20.text: {t0}Kumisiwe noma kuthulisiwe{t1}: i-akhawunti yephule {t2}imithetho yomphakathi{t3}. Igeyimu ikutshela isizathu nokuthi kuze kube nini. Ukuze ukhalaze, sibhalele ne-ID yakho yomdlali kungakapheli izinyanga eziyisithupha: umuntu ongazange athathe isinqumo sokuqala uyakubheka futhi.

pages.support.21.en: {t0}Age group{t1}: the game asks a year of birth once before online play and keeps only the age group. Players under 13 chat only with fixed phrases, get a generated name and cannot be found by name; players aged 13 to 17 start hidden from strangers with their online status off. The game can only make the age group stricter; parents, write to us if your child gave a wrong age.
pages.support.21.text: {t0}Iqembu leminyaka{t1}: igeyimu ibuza unyaka wokuzalwa kanye ngaphambi kokudlala ku-inthanethi futhi igcina iqembu leminyaka kuphela. Abadlali abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-13 baxoxa ngemisho engaguquki kuphela, bathola igama elenziwe futhi abakwazi ukutholwa ngegama; abadlali abaneminyaka eyi-13 kuya kweyi-17 baqala befihliwe kwabangabazi futhi isimo sabo se-inthanethi sivaliwe. Igeyimu ingenza kuphela iqembu leminyaka liqine kakhulu; bazali, sibhaleleni uma ingane yenu inikeze iminyaka engalungile.

pages.support.23.en: Tap {t0}⋯{t1} next to their message in Alliance or Gang chat, in the Alliance member list or on a friend card to {t2}Report{t3} or {t4}Block{t5} them. Blocking hides their chat and requests from you at once. We tell you what we decided about your report, and we never tell the other player who reported them. See the {t6}community rules{t7}. If someone is in danger, contact your local emergency services first.
pages.support.23.text: Thinta {t0}⋯{t1} eduze komlayezo wakhe engxoxweni yoMfelandawonye noma yeviyo, ohlwini lwamalungu oMfelandawonye noma ekhadini lomngane ukuze {t2}Ubike{t3} noma {t4}Uvimbe{t5}. Ukuvimba kufihla ingxoxo yakhe nezicelo zakhe kuwe ngokushesha. Sikutshela ukuthi sinqume ini ngombiko wakho, futhi asisoze samtshela omunye umdlali ukuthi ubani omubikile. Bheka {t6}imithetho yomphakathi{t7}. Uma umuntu esengozini, qala uxhumane nezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo zendawo yakho.

Without the game: {t2}{t3}, with your Player ID or name and a {t4}deletion code{t5}: get one in Settings → Online play → Account while you still have the game (it works once, for 30 days). pages.community.4.en: Kagemura is a game for a general audience, played by people of many ages, countries and languages. By using online play you agree to these rules. Breaking them can get messages removed, chat muted or an account suspended.
pages.community.4.text: I-Kagemura iyigeyimu yabo bonke abantu, edlalwa abantu abaneminyaka ehlukahlukene, abavela emazweni nasezilimini ezihlukene. Ngokusebenzisa ukudlala ku-inthanethi uyavumelana nale mithetho. Ukuyephula kungenza ukuthi imilayezo isuswe, ingxoxo ithuliswe noma i-akhawunti imiswe.

pages.community.5.en: These rules are part of the {t0}{t1}.

pages.community.7.en: No harassment, bullying, threats or hate, in any language, spelling or code word.
pages.community.7.text: Akukho ukuhlukumeza, ukuchwensa, izinsongo noma inzondo, nganoma yiluphi ulimi, upelo noma igama lekhodi.

pages.community.8.en: No sexual content, and nothing that sexualises or endangers children.
pages.community.8.text: Akukho okuqukethwe kocansi, futhi akukho okwenza izingane zibe yizinto zocansi noma okuzifaka engozini.

pages.community.9.en: No names that insult, impersonate another player, staff or a real person, or pretend to be official.
pages.community.9.text: Akukho magama athuka, azenza omunye umdlali, umsebenzi noma umuntu wangempela, noma azenza asemthethweni.

pages.community.10.en: No spam, advertising, scams, or links to cheats.
pages.community.10.text: Akukho spam, izikhangiso, ukukhwabanisa, noma izixhumanisi zokukopela.

pages.community.11.en: Do not share personal details: yours or anyone else's (real name, address, phone, school, social accounts). Never ask other players for them.
pages.community.11.text: Ungabelani ngemininingwane yomuntu siqu: eyakho noma yanoma ubani omunye (igama langempela, ikheli, ucingo, isikole, ama-akhawunti ezinkundla zokuxhumana). Ungalokothi ucele abanye abadlali yona.

pages.community.13.en: Before online play, the game asks for your year of birth (or uses the age range your phone's app store shares) and keeps only an age group, never the date.

pages.community.14.text: Abadlali abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-13 baxoxa ngemilayezo esivele yenziwe kuphela, bagcina igama abaliphiwe yigeyimu, futhi bangatholwa ngekhodi yomngane kuphela.

pages.community.18.en: No cheating: no modified games, bots, scripts or tools that play for you or change battles. Our server checks battles and refuses ones it cannot reproduce.

pages.community.21.en: Do not use other people's payment methods, or refund purchases you used in order to keep them.

pages.community.23.en: {t0}Block{t1}: tap {t2}⋯{t3} next to a message, a member or a friend card. You stop seeing their chat and requests at once, and they can no longer find you or send you friend requests.

pages.account.4.en: Open {t0}Settings → Online play → Account → Delete online account{t1}. Your online account is deleted at once. This works even if you switched to {t2}Play offline{t3}: the game connects just to delete it.

pages.account.6.en: Your player name and online account, the base you shared for raids, and your village if it is kept on our server.

pages.account.7.en: Your friends and friend requests, your Gang membership and your linked sign-ins.

pages.account.8.en: Raids on your village, your Alliance membership, your chat messages, warrior requests and warriors sent to you.

pages.account.10.en: Replays of raids you made stay with the players you raided, shown as "Deleted player". Warriors you sent and Alliance War results stay the same way, without your name.

pages.account.11.en: Copies of your base in other players' recent battles are removed within 30 days.

pages.account.12.en: A village saved on your device stays there: to remove it, uninstall the app, or clear the game site's data in your browser. Purchase records are kept without your Player ID, as tax and refund rules require.

pages.account.14.en: Other players can see Player IDs, so we need proof that the account is yours: a {t0}deletion code{t1}. Get one in the game under {t2}Settings → Online play → Account → Get a deletion code{t3} (it works once, for 30 days), then send it here with your Player ID from the same screen. Staff delete a request with a valid code within 30 days, usually much sooner.

pages.account.15.en: No code, and you can't open the game any more? Send your Player ID anyway and contact support from the game's support page with the reference you get: we can only delete the account once we can confirm it is yours (for example through the Apple, Google or Game Center sign-in linked to it, or a store receipt). We don't ask for an email address here.
